rules.sentence: Celiac disease is an autoimmune disorder triggered by the ingestion of gluten in genetically predisposed individuals, resulting in inflammation and damage (enteropathy) of the small intestinal mucosa.[10]
Dermatitis herpetiformis is an autoimmune condition triggered by gluten ingestion in genetically predisposed individuals.
This condition is regarded as the specific cutaneous manifestation of celiac disease and presents as intensely pruritic vesicles and papules.[11]
